Easing Visualizer

See CSS easing functions in action — the curve drawn on canvas plus a live animated dot and box for each easing.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick an easing function from the list.
  2. Watch the curve draw on the canvas and the dot animate along it.
  3. Copy the CSS timing function for your own animations.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is an easing function?

A math curve that controls how an animation accelerates: linear moves at constant speed, ease-in starts slow, ease-out ends slow, and so on.

What do the CSS keywords map to?

ease = cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), ease-in = (0.42,0,1,1), ease-out = (0,0,0.58,1), ease-in-out = (0.42,0,0.58,1). The rest use standard Robert Penner formulas.

Can I compare two easings?

Switch the dropdown while watching — the animation restarts each time, so back-and-forth comparison is easy.
